notes: Documents and hostile regex compare explicitly configured cache on/off in one feature-enabled binary.
The hostile scanner prepends (a+)+$ to the full TypeScript grammar and uses fresh OnigString identities on every iteration.
The standalone hostile regex is (?:\w+\s*,\s*)*\w+\s*$ on a repeated a followed by !.
The feature-off regression benchmarks compare this working tree with the unmodified base commit; issue163-main is the saved baseline.
Criterion slopes are reported in the companion documentation. Samples and full estimates are retained here; these are local observations, not cross-platform guarantees.
